item.title: How to colorize console output in Node.js
item.description: Colorized terminal output makes CLI tools more readable by visually distinguishing success, errors, and warnings. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve added color output to build scripts, test runners, and deployment tools to make status immediately clear. The standard approach uses the chalk library which handles ANSI escape codes across platforms including Windows. This produces professional-looking terminal output.
